text_copy_copy_copy.text:
Precision with a single incision

Our OmniCurve curved balloon system aims to make your perioperative experience more predictable. With added ability to penetrate varying bone densities, enhanced steering control and maneuverability, and an introducer curve that you trigger, today’s advanced design helps empower you with the capabilities needed to efficiently and reliably reach midline.1

text_copy_copy.text:
Unipedicular access with bipedicular results2

  • Can create equal or larger voids through a single incision3
  • Enables more lateral approach to help maintain distance from spinal cord
  • Requires only one adequate pedicle for access

Please see Instructions for Use (IFU) for a complete listing of warnings, precautions and adverse events.

text_copy.text: 85% reduction in instrument insertion force4
77% reduction in instrument repositioning force4
84% reduction in instrument removal force4

largeheadline_copy.line1: 2.5x

text_copy.text: 2.5x the steering control via stainless steel introducer and bevel-tip4

standaloneimage_copy.alt: OmniCurve curved balloon system featuring enhanced steering control and maneuverability, as well as an introducer curve that you trigger

text_copy_copy_copy_.text:
Intuitive, streamlined unipedicular workflow

One incision, one void, one fill.

A curve you control

Provides a straight, smooth entry down the access cannula, then grip tension lever for controlled, repeatable curved entry into vertebral body.1

Enhanced steering

Bevel-tip provides enhanced midline performance and directional maneuverability in varying bone density.1

Efficient handling

Sheath provides single working channel for introducer, balloon and cement. For further efficiency, the device can be repositioned without disassembly.

text.text: Among the largest balloons on the market, our largest balloon can create a void comparable to bipedicular balloons.5

rte.text:
Features

Intuitive, streamlined unipedicular workflow      

  • One incision, one void, one fill.

A curve you control   

  • Provides straight, smooth entry down access cannula, then controlled, repeatable curved entry into vertebral body with the grip tension lever1.

Enhanced steering       

  • Bevel-tip provides enhanced midline performance and directional maneuverability in varying bone density1.

Designed for efficiency

  • Sheath provides single working channel for introducer, balloon and cement. For further efficiency, the device can be repositioned without disassembly.
